# Fasthosts

> Fasthosts Internet Ltd is a UK-based internet services provider founded in 1999 and headquartered in Gloucester, England. Part of the United Internet group, Fasthosts has served home users, home offices, and SMEs for over 25 years, offering hosting, domains, email, servers, website building, and AI infrastructure products. All infrastructure is UK-based, with data centres in Worcester and London.

## Company

- [About Fasthosts](https://www.fasthosts.co.uk/about): Company background, values, history, and commitment to UK-based support and infrastructure.
- [Data Centres](https://www.fasthosts.co.uk/about/data-centres): Overview of Fasthosts' UK data centres in Worcester and London, covering security, sustainability, and technical capability.
- [Case Studies](https://www.fasthosts.co.uk/case-studies): Customer success stories across a range of industries and product types.
- [Careers](https://www.fasthosts.co.uk/careers): Job opportunities and company culture at Fasthosts HQ in Gloucester.
- [Blog and Content Hub](https://www.fasthosts.co.uk/blog/): Articles, guides, and product updates covering hosting, business growth, and digital services.
- [Business Hub](https://www.fasthosts.co.uk/blog/business-hub/): Practical guidance for starting and growing a business online.
- [Guides and Knowledge Base](https://www.fasthosts.co.uk/guides/): Step-by-step technical guides for setting up and managing Fasthosts products.

## Domains

- [Domain Names](https://www.fasthosts.co.uk/domain-names): Register and manage domain names across a wide range of TLDs, with DNS control included.
- [Domain Transfer](https://www.fasthosts.co.uk/domain-names/transfer): Transfer an existing domain to Fasthosts for free, with competitive renewal pricing.
- [Bulk Domain Search](https://www.fasthosts.co.uk/domain-names/bulk-domain-search): Search and register multiple domains at once to protect a brand or secure variations.
- [.com Domains](https://www.fasthosts.co.uk/domain-names/com-domains): Register and manage .com domain names for a globally recognised online presence.
- [.co.uk Domains](https://www.fasthosts.co.uk/domain-names/co-uk-domains): Register .co.uk domains to establish a UK-specific online presence.
- [.shop Domains](https://www.fasthosts.co.uk/domain-names/shop-domains): Register .shop domains suited to ecommerce and retail businesses.
- [.online Domains](https://www.fasthosts.co.uk/domain-names/online-domains): Register .online domains for broad, globally relevant online projects.
- [.pro Domains](https://www.fasthosts.co.uk/domain-names/pro-domains): Register .pro domains to signal professional expertise or services.
- [Bulk Domain Pricing](https://www.fasthosts.co.uk/domain-names/bulk-domain-pricing): Pricing information for registering multiple domains simultaneously.

## Web Hosting

- [Web Hosting](https://www.fasthosts.co.uk/web-hosting): Linux-based shared hosting plans with free domain and SSL certificate included.
- [Windows Hosting](https://www.fasthosts.co.uk/web-hosting/windows): Windows web hosting with a 99.99% uptime guarantee, suited to ASP.NET and Windows-dependent projects.
- [WordPress Hosting](https://www.fasthosts.co.uk/web-hosting/wordpress): Optimised WordPress hosting with performance enhancements, one-click setup, and AI-assisted tools.
- [WooCommerce Hosting](https://www.fasthosts.co.uk/web-hosting/wordpress/woocommerce): Hosting plans tailored for WooCommerce-powered online stores built on WordPress.
- [Joomla Hosting](https://www.fasthosts.co.uk/web-hosting/joomla): Hosting plans configured for Joomla CMS deployments.
- [Magento Hosting](https://www.fasthosts.co.uk/web-hosting/magento): Hosting plans built for Magento ecommerce sites, with performance and security features included.
- [Reseller Hosting](https://www.fasthosts.co.uk/reseller-hosting): White-label hosting for agencies and developers to resell under their own brand, with full Fasthosts support.

## Website Builder

- [Website Builder](https://www.fasthosts.co.uk/website-builder): Drag-and-drop website builder requiring no coding, with templates and AI tools for fast setup.
- [Ecommerce Website Builder](https://www.fasthosts.co.uk/ecommerce-website-builder): Website builder with integrated ecommerce functionality, free domain, and SSL included.

## Email

- [Professional Email](https://www.fasthosts.co.uk/professional-email): Domain-based email hosting for a professional brand presence.
- [Email Hosting](https://www.fasthosts.co.uk/email-hosting): Overview of all email hosting options available from Fasthosts.
- [Exchange Email](https://www.fasthosts.co.uk/email-hosting/exchange-email): Microsoft Exchange email hosting for businesses needing shared calendars, contacts, and enterprise-grade reliability.
- [Microsoft 365](https://www.fasthosts.co.uk/email-hosting/microsoft-365): Full Microsoft 365 suite with hosted email, Office apps, and a free domain for the first year.
- [Cheap Email Hosting](https://www.fasthosts.co.uk/email-hosting/cheap-email-hosting): Affordable entry-level email hosting plans for individuals and small businesses.

## VPS and Cloud

- [Virtual Private Servers](https://www.fasthosts.co.uk/virtual-private-servers): UK-based VPS hosting with dedicated resources, instant provisioning, and full root access.
- [Linux VPS](https://www.fasthosts.co.uk/virtual-private-servers/linux): Customisable Linux VPS plans at competitive prices, suitable for a broad range of projects.
- [Windows VPS](https://www.fasthosts.co.uk/virtual-private-servers/windows): Windows virtual private servers for projects requiring a Windows environment.
- [Gaming VPS](https://www.fasthosts.co.uk/virtual-private-servers/gaming-vps): VPS solutions configured for game server hosting, with low latency and high performance.
- [n8n VPS](https://www.fasthosts.co.uk/virtual-private-servers/n8n-self-hosted): Self-hosted n8n workflow automation on a Fasthosts VPS, for connecting apps and automating processes.
- [OpenClaw VPS](https://www.fasthosts.co.uk/virtual-private-servers/openclaw-vps): VPS infrastructure designed to keep AI agents running continuously on reliable cloud hardware.
- [Public Cloud](https://www.fasthosts.co.uk/public-cloud): Scalable public cloud for dynamic workloads, with flexible resource management.

## Dedicated and Bare Metal Servers

- [Dedicated Servers](https://www.fasthosts.co.uk/dedicated-servers): Enterprise-grade dedicated server hosting with 100% dedicated resources and advanced security.
- [AMD Dedicated Servers](https://www.fasthosts.co.uk/dedicated-servers/amd): Dedicated servers powered by AMD processors, with customisable specifications.
- [Linux Dedicated Servers](https://www.fasthosts.co.uk/dedicated-servers/linux): Dedicated server hosting running Linux, with scalable configurations and expert support.
- [Windows Dedicated Servers](https://www.fasthosts.co.uk/dedicated-servers/windows): Dedicated servers running Windows Server for enterprise and business workloads.
- [SQL Dedicated Servers](https://www.fasthosts.co.uk/dedicated-servers/sql): Dedicated servers configured specifically for SQL Server hosting, across multiple SQL editions.
- [Storage Servers](https://www.fasthosts.co.uk/dedicated-servers/storage-servers): High-capacity dedicated storage servers for data management, archiving, and backups.
- [Dedicated Server Deals](https://www.fasthosts.co.uk/dedicated-servers/deals): Current promotional pricing on dedicated server configurations.
- [Bare Metal Servers](https://www.fasthosts.co.uk/cloud-servers/bare-metal): Physical dedicated hardware with cloud-style flexible billing -- Intel and AMD options available.
- [Ampere Arm Servers](https://www.fasthosts.co.uk/arm-servers): Energy-efficient Ampere Arm-based servers for cloud computing and scalable workloads.
- [GPU Servers](https://www.fasthosts.co.uk/gpu-servers): High-performance servers with Nvidia or Intel GPUs, suited to AI, machine learning, and intensive data processing.

## AI and Automation

- [AI App & Site Builder](https://www.fasthosts.co.uk/spark/ai-app-site-builder): No-code AI website builder that turns a chat prompt into a website or web app, with hosting, domain and SSL included.
- [AI Receptionist](https://www.fasthosts.co.uk/spark/ai-receptionist): AI-powered phone receptionist that handles business calls around the clock, including out-of-hours.
- [OpenClaw VPS](https://www.fasthosts.co.uk/virtual-private-servers/openclaw-vps): Cloud infrastructure for hosting AI agents with guaranteed uptime and persistent operation.
- [n8n VPS](https://www.fasthosts.co.uk/virtual-private-servers/n8n-self-hosted): Self-hosted workflow automation platform for connecting services and building automated pipelines.
- [GPU Servers](https://www.fasthosts.co.uk/gpu-servers): GPU-accelerated servers for AI model training, inference, and large-scale data processing.

## Security and Backup

- [Cloud Backup](https://www.fasthosts.co.uk/cyber-protect): Comprehensive data backup and cybersecurity solution powered by Acronis Cyber Protect, covering 20+ platforms.

## Online Marketing

- [Online Marketing Suite](https://www.fasthosts.co.uk/online-marketing): Digital marketing tools including SEO, local listings, and visibility features to help businesses get found online.

## Partners, Affiliates, and Resellers

- [Partner Programme](https://www.fasthosts.co.uk/partner-programme): Rewards, revenue share, and dedicated support for agencies, freelancers, and solution providers.
- [Partner Network](https://www.fasthosts.co.uk/partner-network/): Directory connecting Fasthosts customers with trusted web professionals.
- [Affiliate Programme](https://www.fasthosts.co.uk/affiliates): Earn commission by promoting Fasthosts hosting products through an affiliate link.
- [Referral Scheme](https://www.fasthosts.co.uk/referral-scheme): Rewards for existing customers who refer new customers to Fasthosts.
- [Reseller Hosting](https://www.fasthosts.co.uk/reseller-hosting): White-label hosting resale with full technical support provided by Fasthosts.

## Support and Legal

- [Support](https://www.fasthosts.co.uk/support): 24/7 customer support portal with guides, live chat, and phone access.
- [Contact](https://www.fasthosts.co.uk/contact): Contact page for sales and support enquiries.
- [Talk to Sales](https://www.fasthosts.co.uk/talk-to-sales): Direct line to the Fasthosts sales team for product guidance and custom requirements.
- [Terms of Service](https://www.fasthosts.co.uk/terms): Full terms and conditions governing use of Fasthosts products and services.
- [Privacy Notice](https://www.fasthosts.co.uk/terms/policies/privacy-notice): Details of how Fasthosts collects, processes, and stores personal data.
- [Cookie Policy](https://www.fasthosts.co.uk/terms/policies/cookie-policy): Explanation of cookie usage and consent options on the Fasthosts website.
- [UK Tax Strategy](https://www.fasthosts.co.uk/terms/tax-strategy): United Internet AG's UK tax strategy and approach to tax compliance.
- [Modern Slavery Statement](https://www.fasthosts.co.uk/terms/policies/slavery-and-human-trafficking-statement): Fasthosts' commitment to preventing modern slavery in its operations and supply chain.
